title: sanitizeName omits the keyword-prefix step, diverging from backend _sanitize_func_name for Python-keyword labels (e.g. "class" -> frontend "class" vs backend "node_class")
description: The frontend sanitizeName() is explicitly documented to stay in sync with the backend src/haute/_graph_utils.py::_sanitize_func_name (see the file's own docstring and the comment block at NodePanel.tsx:699-708). The backend performs FOUR final guards: (1) prefix node_ if the result starts with a digit, (2) prefix node_ if the result is a Python keyword via keyword.iskeyword(name), then (3) fall back to unnamed_node. The frontend implements only guards (1) and (3) and SKIPS the keyword guard entirely. There is no keyword check anywhere in frontend/src (grep for iskeyword/keyword finds only CodeMirror syntax-highlight tokens). Consequently, for any node whose label sanitises to a reserved Python keyword (class, return, import, for, if, def, lambda, while, with, yield, global, None, True, False, and, or, not, in, is, etc.), the two implementations disagree: backend produces e.g. "node_class" but frontend produces "class". sanitizeName feeds load-bearing identifiers in NodePanel.tsx: upstream input varNames for wiring (lines 244, 254, 360, 636), and the api_input cache configPath `config/quote_input/${sanitizeName(label)}.json` (line 708). The backend writes/reads these under the keyword-prefixed name. The mismatch reproduces exactly the class of bug the NodePanel.tsx:699-708 comment says was fixed: the frontend computes a name the backend never wrote, so the api_input cache-status GET resolves to the wrong path -> silent cached=false / unresponsive cache button; and editor-displayed input variable names disagree with the names in generated code. The keyword guard is necessary precisely because str.isidentifier() returns True for keywords (so the identifier-validity invariant alone does not catch them) - the backend's own test_parser_sanitize_contracts.py::test_round_trip_stability_on_ascii deliberately includes "class" in its candidate list.
evidence: Backend _graph_utils.py:121-125: `if name and name[0].isdigit(): name = f"node_{name}"` then `if keyword.iskeyword(name): name = f"node_{name}"` then `return name or "unnamed_node"`. Frontend sanitizeName.ts:36-37: `if (name && /^[0-9]/.test(name)) name = \`node_${name}\`` then `return name || "unnamed_node"` -- the keyword branch is absent. So sanitizeName("class") === "class" while _sanitize_func_name("class") === "node_class". NodePanel.tsx:708 builds `config/quote_input/${sanitizeName(node.data.label)}.json`, and codegen.py:546/_save_pipeline.py:229 build the backend-side names via _sanitize_func_name -> the two paths/idents differ for keyword labels.
